hooks.description: When a new order is confirmed, generate a plain-text kitchen ticket in data/tickets/TICKET-<number>.txt. This is the simulated print for the demo.
hooks.name: dead-line-diner-new-order-ticket
hooks.note: This is a Kiro hook CONFIG (JSON). In the Phase 1 prototype the server already performs this step inline (see writeTicket() in server/server.mjs), so the ticket is generated even without a hook runner. The script scripts/hook-new-order-ticket.js is the standalone, runnable version of the same step, for use when the hook is wired to an external event.
